lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-random grid pattern posterior to the branchial region. The centroids are organized into roughly parallel vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with circular spots, creating a lattice where the spots serve as nodes within the vertical stripe vectors.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear ridges extending along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (upper) to shadow-cast low-intensity (lower).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of small, high-luminance blobs located within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing a lower spatial frequency compared to the primary lateral flank constellation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, elongated, irregular white linear feature originating on the upper mid-flank and extending diagonally towards the pectoral fin base, intersecting several vertical stripes and spot rows.
